llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the tap target under `GestureHandlerRootView` and attach gestures with `GestureDetector gesture={...}` from `react-native-gesture-handler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: GestureDetector with gesture={composed} is present, but there is no GestureHandlerRootView wrapping the component tree. The requirement mandates rendering the tap target under GestureHandlerRootView.
evidence: App.tsx: GestureDetector is used but GestureHandlerRootView is never imported or rendered

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define both gestures with `Gesture.Tap()` builders (`singleTap` and `doubleTap`) using current builder callbacks (`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both gestures are defined with Gesture.Tap() builders using onEnd callbacks. No useAnimatedGestureHandler is present.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` inside tap `onEnd` success paths to update React state and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onEnd callbacks call setStatus directly on the JS thread without scheduleOnRN(). The requirement explicitly mandates scheduleOnRN(...) and prohibits runOnJS; neither is used here.
evidence: App.tsx:10: setStatus('Single tap') — direct call, no scheduleOnRN
App.tsx:14: setStatus('Double tap') — direct call, no scheduleOnRN

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose taps with `Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap)` so exclusivity is defined by RNGH composition APIs.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Taps are composed with Gesture.Race(doubleTap, singleTap) instead of the required Gesture.Exclusive(doubleTap, singleTap).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure tap-recognition windows via `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(2).maxDelay(...)` for double tap and `Gesture.Tap().numberOfTaps(1)` for single tap, with explicit duration limits via `maxDuration(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: doubleTap is missing both numberOfTaps(2) is present but maxDelay(...) is absent. singleTap uses maxDuration(250) but is missing the explicit numberOfTaps(1) call. Neither gesture fully satisfies the specified configuration contract.
